gates.note: The checker reports request_compile.cpp and helmholtz_model.hpp as reading the active trace because its regex treats every active(...) token as a trace read.

stop_detail: Stopped at gate 2 before gate 3. The corrected brief requires a public accessor spelled active() const and its use in request_compile.cpp, but rule_core_and_trace_boundaries uses (?<![A-Za-z0-9_])(core::)?(Capture\b|active\s*\(), which rejects any unqualified active(...) token outside bindings. The mandated accessor therefore makes the unchanged architecture gate red. Fixing that checker regex is not among the brief's authorized edits. The model accessor and analytic packing coefficient derivatives were written within their ceilings; gate 1 passed.
